name: Williams Blackwell-Cotton Valley Expansion

values.Owner: Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline Inc

researcher_notes: This is an operating 2001 lateral, not a proposal. The EIA historical projects table (sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 213) lists Williams Blackwell-Cotton Valley Expansion, operator Williams Gas Pipelines Central, FERC docket CP99-576, completed November 2001, 36.8 miles, 55 MMcf/d, diameters 16 and 20 inches, Kansas and Missouri. A Natural Gas Intel item from 2000 reports the FERC certificate for 55,000 Dth/d and 37 miles of 20-inch pipe in Labette and Cherokee Counties, Kansas. The EIA release and the news item are not clearly independent of each other, so tier is medium. It is not an existing row: the system row P0253 (Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline, formerly Williams Gas Pipelines Central) has no expansion row. Owner is the current operator of the system, Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline Inc, an existing gas-tracker entity; the 2001 sponsor was Williams. Exact start and end points were not found, only the two counties; the EIA state list adds Missouri, which the news item does not mention. No route found. Added length is about 59 km, above the 25 km threshold.
